BXM.what: CBOE S&P 500 BuyWrite — the covered-call half of the wheel

GSPC.what: S&P 500 PRICE index — kept only to show the ~1.8%/yr dividend gap a price benchmark hides

PUT.what: CBOE S&P 500 PutWrite — the cash-secured-put half

SP500TR.what: S&P 500 TOTAL RETURN — the correct benchmark

_note: BXM and PUT are TOTAL-RETURN strategy indices. Benchmark them against SP500TR, never GSPC — the price index omits ~1.8%/yr of dividends the covered-call writer actually receives.
